description: Authoritative phone-to-vehicle mounting alignment status enum as defined by Architecture Revision 3 Component C-05.

definitions.UNINITIALIZED: Initial unknown mounting orientation relative to vehicle chassis prior to alignment convergence.
definitions.VALID: Stable alignment achieved; phone-to-vehicle rotation matrix is valid and calibrated.
definitions.UNCERTAIN: Alignment covariance exceeds confidence threshold or dynamic excitation is insufficient.
definitions.SLIP_SUSPECTED: Mount kinematic anomaly or sudden displacement detected; realignment required.
